title: General.
officialText:
Pool and spa heaters shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer’s installation instructions. Oil-fired
pool and spa heaters shall be tested in accordance with UL 726. Electric pool and spa heaters shall be tested in accordance with
UL 1261.
SECTION MC 917
COOKING APPLIANCES
